Hello all,

I am Cally, and will be going into a Master's year at university this October.

I have been working through the 'Mathematics in Lean' textbook from GitHub, and am about halfway through at this point. I really like the idea of formalising mathematics and being able to do so, so I was wondering if there was anyone here I'd be able to be any use to over the summer, or if I should just keep working through the book for the time being.

I have done algebra and number theory more than anything else, but I wouldn't be surprised if those areas are two of the furthest along, as far as mathlib is concerned. Any advice is greatly appreciated.

(Very sorry, I'm also new to Zulip, so I may have accidentally sent this message to someone else's topic the first time)
